Assuming \(\log(x)\) is the natural logarithm, use integration by parts:

Let \(u = \log(x)\), so \(du = \frac{1}{x} dx\).

Let \(dv = dx\), so \(v = x\).

Then:

\[
\int \log(x) dx = x * \log(x) - \int x * \frac{1}{x} dx
\]

\[
= x * \log(x) - \int 1 dx
\]

\[
= x * \log(x) - x + C
\]

<answer>x*log(x) - x + C</answer>
